representation: Vocabulary-free aligned copy/edit runs; ambiguous alignments abstain. Same Rule/StructuralSeed, separate demand-loaded module.
identity_supervision: Public train statements paired with themselves, one per distinct whitespace length, up to the declared cap. Label Entailment=1 is a supplied supervised logical axiom, not autonomous discovery or external-authorship evaluation.
selection: All original validation pairs. Maximize correct, then fewer rules, then policy order. Public test consumed before this protocol, never a fresh reserve.
acceptance: Development experiment, not full M1 approval. Keep all errors and abstentions; independently test reflexivity and adversarial consistency before any promotion. Do not override low coverage using conditional accuracy.
limits: 300 seconds per process; existing structural/genome quotas unchanged. No second agent, LLM, energy or RSS claim.
